intro: One place for everything that is booked: rooms, tables, a stylist's chair, an appointment, a machine or a vehicle. Bookings is not a pack of its own: it is the booking engine the restaurant, accommodation and other packs share, and it never lets the same thing be booked twice.
start: Add what can be booked in Rooms, tables and staff, grouped into room types, areas or teams.
Make the offers guests book in Offers and rates, with how long each lasts and what it costs.
Set your opening hours and the days you are closed in Hours and closures.
Check Booking rules: cancelling, no-shows, what guests may change themselves and the waiting list.
Make a booking page and share its link, so guests can book without an account.
